title: Sr. Application Developer I (II)
description:
Flexible Work Arrangement: Hybrid - Audubon, PA

The Application Architecture team is transforming the way web applications are developed at PJM. Our team is responsible for developing the next generation of web applications and system integration solutions at PJM.  Utilizing leading technical concepts and technologies, the group is collaboratively building application frameworks, architecture, products, and services to enable PJM's core business to be more flexible and reliable, as well as more responsive to our membership companies.

In this role, you will collaborate with other developers, business analysts, testers, and business subject matter experts to develop innovative solutions for new web applications and/or new features for PJM's existing web applications and system integrations. This includes translating business requirements, user stories, and wireframes into a working application, as well as automating functional tests, and writing effective technical support documentation. Applications are written in various high-level languages and developers must be able to pick up new technologies quickly, be a strong team players, and rapidly adapt to changing business needs.

Essential Functions:

- Understand the development needs of the business units and establish a positive, service-oriented relationship by ensuring timely and accurate delivery of application services and systems.

- Learn the business – develop a solid understanding of the business functions and processes and implement solutions based on that understanding and communicate this understanding across the teams.

- Establish and maintain high client satisfaction levels.

- Document, track and resolve problems to support client and core business systems.

- Responsible for technical deliverables associated with application code development, including requirements documentation, functional design documents and specifications, work estimates, detailed technical design documentation, application code and associated documentation, including documentation to fulfill audit requirements.

- Determine (Sr./Lead) and document technical requirements for application systems, including system, module and unit design, unit test plans and test cases.

- Support all phases of the software development lifecycle, including Requirements Gathering, Analysis, Design, Testing, Implementation, and Production support for PJM software systems.

- Develop, debug and test computer applications based on user requirements documentation, and on input from subject matter experts.

- Leads (Sr./Lead) or participates in code reviews.

- Participate as a member of a cross-functional Scrum team.

- Debug, remediate and enhance existing computer applications based on documented variances and enhancement requests, and with guidance from subject matter experts.

- Follow the approved methodology for application systems development and maintenance.

- Respond, as necessary, to support calls in off-hours in order to support 24X7 applications.

- Assist business clients and product teams in integrating systems from external vendors.

- Identify enhancements to application development standards and best practices.

- Build and develop strong relationships with ITS' business clients by providing superior customer support as demonstrated by clearly owning, resolving and communicating issues and problems, and being responsive to needs, requirements, and deadlines.

- Leverages expertise in enterprise integration patterns with SOA-based ESBs to develop or extend legacy system integration with the PJM SOA Architecture.

- Supports the operation of a continuous integration environment, including development of automated test cases (unit and function).

Characteristics & Qualifications:
Required

- Bachelor of Science, Computer Science, Bachelor of Science, Information Technology or equivalent experience.

- High-level programming languages including Java, .NET and other languages.

- Experience with software development lifecycle, architecture patterns and data integrations methodologies.

- Expertise integrating applications with database systems including Oracle, MS SQL and Postgres.

Preferred

- Master of Science, Computer Science

- Experience with PJM operations, markets, and planning functions

title: (Sr.) (Lead) (Principal) Energy Analyst/Engineer (II)
description:
Flexible Work Arrangement: Hybrid - Audubon, PA

The Sr. (Lead) Analyst/Engineer will support the Capacity Market Operations Department to successfully manage the $12 billion per year PJM Capacity Market that is used to ensure the reliability of the PJM system. This is a dynamic and exciting area where the PJM resource mix and associated market rules evolve based on competition, public policy and new technologies. The team manages all aspects of the capacity market including helping our members with their specific needs. The candidate will have the opportunity to help determine the future policy, processes and systems to support one of the largest capacity wholesale markets in the world.

The candidate will help manage the capacity auction clearing process and associated financial settlement. This will involve the management of the inputs, optimization engine and outputs of the RPM auction clearing process and the publication of associated public reports. The candidate will also help with the financial analysis of default minimum offer prices, default maximum offer prices, reference resource price used to determine the demand curve and power plant estimated net revenues.

The candidate will support various software integration projects to implement changes to PJM market rules and upgrades to new technology. The successful candidate will be responsible for documenting detailed functional and technical requirements, will work closely with the software development team to implement those requirements, and will be responsible for ensuring the software delivery meets the business need. The candidate will support various software integration projects to implement changes to PJM market rules and upgrades to new technology. The successful candidate will be responsible for documenting detailed functional and technical requirements, will work closely with the software development team to implement those requirements, and will be responsible for ensuring the software delivery meets the business need.

Essential Functions:

- Administer the auction process and publish the associated analysis of the results.

- Financial analysis of power plant costs and revenues to determine default floor and cap prices used for mitigation and price used to determine the demand curve.

- Provide exceptional customer service to the membership. Must be able to address specific customer issues in a clear, concise and professional manner through excellent communication.

- Develop and produce performance metrics, reports, empirical analysis and presentations to improve the transparency and operation of the PJM Capacity market.

- Work on a collaborative basis to determine, define and test system solutions for changes in market rules and/or to improve the effectiveness of the overall operational processes.

- Read, analyze and understand PJM Tariff and Manuals in order to convert market rules into robust operational processes.

- Develop and update training material (MS PowerPoint documents) and assist with training stakeholders.

Characteristics & Qualifications:
Required

- Bachelor Degree: Economics, Engineering, Finance, Computer Science or other similar major.

- At least 3 years of experience in data analytics and quantitative analysis using SAS, SQL, Python or other similar tools. Must be able to consolidate data into meaningful information.

- Track record that demonstrates attention to detail – must be able to verify work is complete and accurate. Implement quality controls to minimize operational risks.

- Proficient with MS Excel including the development and maintenance of complex workbooks.

- Customer focused with ability to communicate effectively (verbal and written)

- Knowledge of electricity wholesale markets.

Preferred

- Graduate degree (PhD, MA, MS or MBA)

- Experience with the PJM capacity market rules and the settlement process.

- Power plant financial modelling and analysis

title: (Sr./Lead) Market Design Specialist I (II)
description:
Flexible Work Arrangement: Hybrid

This position is seeking a talented and motivated Market Design Specialist to join our dynamic team. The Market Design Specialist will work directly with the Manager of market design in support of significant market design enhancements across all PJM's markets and will be responsible for designing, analyzing and optimizing the market structures and rules to ensure efficiency, sustainability, and of most importance, reliability of the power system amongst the energy transition. You will collaborate with interdisciplinary teams, PJM stakeholders, and regulatory bodies to develop innovative solutions that address the evolving needs of the electricity markets.
If you are passionate about shaping the future of electricity markets, draw satisfaction from solving complex problems, and building consensus among large groups of people – this job is for you!

Essential Functions:

Market Analysis and Research:

- Conduct comprehensive analysis of electricity market trends and other ISO/RTO market rules and practices to identity opportunities or inform design decisions

- Market Design and Analysis:

- Demonstrates the ability to work independently in the performance of complex studies and analysis of issues.

- Offers concepts and strategies pertaining to market design that will enable PJM to remain at the top of its field

- Possesses a working knowledge of PJM markets and understanding of the PJM Agreements and Tariffs.

- Applies expertise in solving new and complex problems and develops innovative strategies to evolve the PJM markets.

- Develops position papers to support market design alternatives and facilitate internal decision making on complex market design matters

Stakeholder and Regulatory Engagement:

- Manages the conflicting expectations of the various sectors represented by the market participants.

- Develops and delivers presentations on complex ideas to internal and external stakeholders

- Assists in the development of revisions to the PJM governing documents to support proposed market design changes

- Works closely with PJM legal counsel in the development of FERC filings to support proposed market design changes, including drafting and revising transmittal letters and affidavits.

Project Management:

- Leads the implementation of complex market design initiatives, driving cross-functional internal teams to consensus on selected market design approaches

Characteristics and Qualifications:
Required:

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics, Mathematics or equivalent work experience

- 5 years of experience Engineer/Analyst position

- Ability to produce high-quality work products with attention to detail

- Experience in quantitative and qualitative analysis

- Ability to use mathematical and electrical theory

- Ability to troubleshoot and provide technical support

PJM is not STEM OPT eligible. Immigration sponsorship is not available for this position.
Preferred:

- MS degree in Engineering or at least 8 years of experience Sr. Engineer/Sr. Analyst

- At least 8 years of experience Sr. Engineer/Sr. Analyst

- Experience with PJM operations, markets, and planning functions

title: Sr. Market Strategist I (II)
description:
Flexible Work Arrangement: Hybrid

The Sr. Market Strategist, Renewable Services position supports the Renewable Services department in providing business leadership for PJM Environmental Information Services, Inc. (PJM EIS), which administers the Generation Attribute Tracking System (GATS).
This position also provides technical and business support to the Market Services division and the PJM membership in addressing PJM markets issues related to variable energy resources such as solar, wind and storage resources. This position provides technical expertise to the Market Services division related to state and federal renewable energy and environmental regulations and their potential impacts to PJM.

Essential Functions:

- Manage the day-to-day operation of GATS.

- Supervise GATS customer hotline staff, including scheduling their daily assignments.

- Coordinate the design, testing, and implementation of all software fixes and enhancements to PJM EIS systems.

- Lead periodic meetings of the GATS stakeholder groups (both subscribers and state agencies).

- Develop and maintain documentation and customer training materials for PJM EIS.

- Coordinate outreach and manage relationships with state regulatory personnel responsible for renewable energy programs.

- Perform data analyses and reporting to support regulatory, customer, and internal information requests.

- Proactively identify and suggest innovative solutions to business problems.

Characteristics and Qualifications:
Required:

- Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, Environmental Engineering, Industrial Engineering or equivalent work experience

- 0-5 years of experience SQL and Data Research

- Ability to apply economic and statistical theory to complex market problems

- Ability to produce high-quality work products with attention to detail

- Ability to visualize and solve complex problems

- Ability to apply analytical and mathematical solutions

- Experience in quantitative and qualitative analysis

- Ability to speak and present publicly

Preferred:

Experience with PJM operations, markets, and planning functions
